title: National non-profit care-sector demonstration in Brussels
location: Brussels: route beginning near the small ring, ending planned at Brussels South Station
organizer: National trade-union front / non-profit sector unions
threshold_50_evidence: Two explicit estimates in the opened report both exceed 50; code lower 18,500 and upper 22,500, preserving their sources.

start_date.summary: BRUZZ dates the national demonstration to 31 January.

location.summary: Route began near the small ring; speeches were planned at Brussels South Station.

scope.summary: Reported as a national union demonstration in Brussels.

organizer.summary: National union action involving non-profit/care-sector workers.

demands.summary: Workers sought action on workload and staffing shortages, and better pay and working conditions.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Both directly reported estimates are well above the manual 50-person threshold.

end_date.summary: Physical end of the gathering is not documented; scheduled closing speeches do not establish actual end.

protester_violence.summary: No event-specific evidence sufficient to code violence by protesters; silence or unidentified bangs do not establish it.

state_response.summary: Event-specific seven response variables remain unknown absent explicit evidence.

notes: BRUZZ credits Belga, so its count is not an independent agency stream from Belga reproductions. BX1 independently reports the demands but not a crowd total. AP exact article is under the inherited hold and was not requested. Article mentions bangs without attributing them; no violence is coded.
open_questions: Physical end time and post-march continuity are unknown.
Confirm whether the second crowd estimate is independently produced or union-side only.

title: Firefighters’ union protest at Arts-Loi / Rue de la Loi
location: Arts-Loi / Rue de la Loi, Brussels
organizer: Firefighters’ union representatives; exact organizing union(s) unresolved
participants_original: Brussels Times reports a protest; BX1 headline says 200, while its body describes about 50 initially and more arriving from Wallonia.
threshold_50_evidence: Opened reports establish a gathering at the threshold edge, but counts conflict: BX1 body says about 50 at first plus further arrivals, while its headline says 200 and the Brussels Times report describes a delegation. Distinct final attendance is unresolved.

start_date.summary: Both contemporary reports date the action to Friday 27 January 2023.

location.summary: At Arts-Loi / Rue de la Loi in Brussels.

organizer.summary: Firefighters’ union action; a delegation was received by the Brussels Minister-President.

demands.summary: Protesters sought staffing, investment and improved work/end-of-career conditions.

participants.summary: BX1 headline says 200; body describes about 50 at first and further Walloon arrivals. No reconciled number.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: A reported initial group of about 50 plus arrivals makes threshold plausible but not securely established at 50 distinct participants.

state_accommodation.summary: Brussels Times reports a delegation met the Minister-President. Under the consulted manual’s accommodation definition, an authority meeting protest leadership is accommodation; this is not a concession.

state_response.summary: No other response variables established; only the meeting noted above is coded.

notes: Threshold remains pending because the report’s body and headline, and another outlet, do not yield a stable count. A meeting with the Minister-President is coded accommodation only; no demand concession is implied.
open_questions: Was the final unique crowd at least 50?
Which union(s) organized the delegation and when did the action physically end?

title: Rally seeking release of Olivier Vandecasteele
participants_original: NOS: around 1,000; Brussels Times: police/VRT about 1,000 and organizers 1,000–1,500.
threshold_50_evidence: Two opened contemporary reports place attendance at roughly 1,000 or more.

start_date.summary: Both reports date the Brussels rally to 22 January 2023.

organizer.summary: Support group and campaigners for Vandecasteele organized the rally.

demands.summary: Release Vandecasteele and ask Belgian officials to use diplomatic pressure on Iran.

participants.summary: NOS reports around 1,000; Brussels Times attributes about 1,000 to police/VRT and 1,000–1,500 to organizers.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: All reported estimates are far above 50.

end_date.summary: Physical end of the rally not established.

protester_violence.summary: No event-specific evidence to code; remains unknown.

state_response.summary: Seven state response variables remain unknown absent explicit event-specific evidence.

notes: The grievance concerned detention by Iran, while the rally explicitly asked Belgian politicians to pressure Iran. Proposed inclusion treats that as a demand directed to Belgium’s own state policy; coordinator should review this target interpretation. Crowd sources are not claimed independent absent established origin details.
open_questions: Confirm country-state target coding for diplomatic pressure directed through Belgian officials.
Physical ending and any subsequent continuation are unknown.

title: Ostend municipal workers’ public action over local cuts
location: Outside Ostend municipal government buildings / city hall area
organizer: ACOD LRB regional committee; ACV/ACOD/VSOA union front described
participants_original: WSWS reports about 400 joined a strike and protests outside government buildings; the components are not separated.
threshold_50_evidence: Not established separately: the approximately 400 figure combines people striking and protesting; the number at a distinct qualifying public gathering is unknown.

start_date.summary: ACOD LRB dates the Ostend action to 9 January 2023.

location.summary: Public action at Ostend municipal government buildings / city hall area.

organizer.summary: ACOD LRB regional committee and the local public-sector union front.

demands.summary: Opposed local cuts, privatization and changes affecting municipal services/work.

participants.summary: WSWS reports about 400 in a combined strike-and-protest figure, attributing its account to HLN.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The source does not separate public protest participants from strikers; 400 cannot be applied as a distinct protest count.

protester_violence.summary: Unknown; no violence inference from silence.

state_response.summary: All seven state response variables remain unknown.

notes: The union report confirms an action; the secondary 400 estimate combines the strike and protest and attributes its account to HLN. The exact HLN page was not opened; Q028 reported robots.txt blocking. No count assigned to participants.
open_questions: Determine whether at least 50 people attended the public gathering, distinct from workplace strike participation.
Clarify exact venue and physical ending.

title: Police-union rally at Federal Police headquarters
participants_original: Anadolu Agency text/captions report approximately 300 police officers.
threshold_50_evidence: Anadolu describes hundreds / approximately 300 officers at the rally; union archive independently records the action date and site but not a second headcount.

start_date.summary: Anadolu and the union archive place the police-union rally at headquarters on 11 January.

demands.summary: Higher pay and better pension/end-of-career terms.

participants.summary: Anadolu text/captions report roughly 300; ACV archive confirms an action but not its attendance.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The only quantified report describes about 300 participants, above 50.

state_response.summary: All seven state response variables remain unknown.

notes: The event is distinct from the later 23 January action at Bozar. Attendance has one quantified news source; union documentation corroborates date/site, not the number.
open_questions: Seek independent contemporary attendee count if available.
Physical end and state response are unreported.

title: Police-union action at Open VLD New Year reception in Bozar
location: Bozar / Open VLD New Year reception, Brussels
participants_original: ACV Police archive says several hundred union members gathered.
threshold_50_evidence: Union archive explicitly describes several hundred participants, which exceeds 50; the figure is qualitative rather than numeric.

start_date.summary: ACV Police archive and the Chamber transcript identify the action at the 23 January Open VLD reception.

location.summary: Bozar, Brussels, during the Open VLD New Year reception.

organizer.summary: Several police unions participated; the archive describes four unions.

demands.summary: Higher wages and changes to the end-of-career scheme.

participants.summary: ACV Police archive describes several hundred union members; no exact number.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: “Several hundred” is explicit qualitative evidence above 50.

state_response.summary: The Chamber transcript mentions the action but does not establish a state response; all variables remain unknown.

notes: Kept separate from the 11 January police rally at Federal Police headquarters: distinct date, venue and target. No evidence shows one continuous gathering.
open_questions: Exact attendance and physical end remain unknown.
No independent contemporary count found; union archive and parliamentary record have different roles.

title: Sourour Abouda justice and clarification gathering
location: Rue Royale 202A / near Federal Police complex, Brussels
organizer: Sourour Abouda’s family and PAC (as reported)
threshold_50_evidence: Opened report explicitly describes more than 100 mourners at the gathering.

start_date.summary: VICE reports the gathering on Sunday 15 January 2023.

location.summary: At rue Royale 202A, by the Federal Police complex in Brussels.

organizer.summary: VICE describes the family and PAC as organizers/supporters; the Chamber transcript records a PAC gathering seeking clarification.

demands.summary: Demanded truth, justice and clarification about Sourour Abouda’s death in police custody.

protester_violence.summary: The custody death is background and is not protester violence at this event.

state_response.summary: No event-specific response evidence; prior police custody is not coded as this event’s response.

notes: This event concerns the state police/prosecution response to a custody death. That prior death does not establish violence or killings during this gathering. A separate Stuut result announces a 12 January commemoration, but its body could not be read and relation to this Jan 15 event is unresolved.
open_questions: Resolve whether the 12 January Stuut announcement was a separate gathering or a duplicate/misdated notice.
Physical end and event-specific state response are unknown.

title: Prison-union gathering outside Groen headquarters during strike
participants_original: No realized attendance count reported; VRT preview expected 70–80 unionists, while BRUZZ confirms a gathering but gives no turnout.
threshold_50_evidence: Not established: the 70–80 figure was a pre-event expectation, not observed attendance; later report confirms a gathering without counting participants.

start_date.summary: VRT’s preview and BRUZZ’s report place the union gathering on 11 January.

demands.summary: Pay and a thirteenth-month payment, alongside prison working conditions.

participants.summary: VRT forecast 70–80 unionists before the action; BRUZZ reports the gathering but no actual count.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Forecast attendance cannot establish realized threshold; actual count is absent.

state_response.summary: Possible reported meeting with a minister is too unclear to code accommodation; all response variables remain unknown.

notes: Separate from the prison staff strike itself: this record is only the publicly reported union gathering. The strike alone is not counted as a protest event. Expected attendance is not actual attendance.
open_questions: Confirm realized attendance of at least 50.
Clarify whether federal minister Petra De Sutter actually met protest leadership and whether that qualifies as accommodation.

title: Farmers’ protest at N-VA New Year reception in Mechelen
organizer: Farmers; named organizing group not identified
threshold_50_evidence: Not established: Belga confirms a farmers’ tractor protest at the reception entrance but gives no protester headcount. N-VA’s thousands of party attendees were inside the reception and are not protest attendance.

start_date.summary: Contemporaneous Belga story says the action occurred Saturday 14 January; a retrospective reference to “first few days” is less precise.

location.summary: At the entrance to Nekkerhal in Mechelen, where the N-VA reception was held.

organizer.summary: Farmers protested; no specific organizing body named in opened evidence.

demands.summary: Opposed the Flemish nitrogen/PAS agreement and its impact on agriculture.

participants.summary: No protester attendance estimate in opened evidence. N-VA reports thousands of reception members inside, which are not protest participants.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Presence of tractors and farmers establishes a gathering but does not verify at least 50 distinct participants.

end_date.summary: Physical ending and any continuation are not reported.

protester_violence.summary: No event-specific violence evidence; remains unknown.

state_response.summary: All seven response variables remain unknown.

notes: Do not use party-reception attendance as protest attendance. The opened Belga report verifies the protest and policy issue but no crowd size. No attendance number is inferred from tractors or search snippets.
open_questions: Establish whether 50 or more people attended the protest itself.
Identify organizer(s), exact turnout and physical ending.
